title: Kusanagi Nene — Unwavering Gaze〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Morinomiya Music Academy

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Let's see... The classroom for my next lesson should be this way.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'd like to get there early in order to check to make sure I'm moving okay.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, this is where...

rows.Speaker: Imura
rows.Line: Stop it.

rows.Speaker: Imura
rows.Line: I don't want to hear any empty words! Not from someone who didn't get cut today!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (This is where I had that talk with Imura...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I haven't seen her since she was told to stop auditioning the other day... I hope she's okay.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I know I should focus on the show itself, but...)

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
Huh? Kusanagi...?
What are you doing in the middle of the corridor? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, Byakkomachi...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Umm... I was just thinking about something, is all.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
I see.
Then, I apologize for interrupting your train of thought.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, we should be heading to class, after all. I appreciate you speaking up.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Ah, I'm glad to hear that.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um, Byakkomachi?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Do you know if Imura's okay?
I haven't forgotten about what you told me the other day, but...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
She should be fine.
It's nothing for you to worry about, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
Anyway, shall we?
We probably shouldn't spend all our time chatting here.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: R-Right, let's go.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (So, is she telling me again to stop thinking about Imura and stay focused on the production?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It's still a bit of a bitter pill to swallow...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(But...
I do need to do everything I can for the task ahead of me.)
After the lesson

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Phew... Another tough lesson today, but I feel like I'm moving my body much better now.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Still, I'm miles behind the others.
I should probably head over to SEKAI to do my usual training and...)
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Imura
rows.Line: Hi, Kusanagi...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Imura?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
U-Uhh, so... How are you feeling?
You haven't been showing up for our lessons.

rows.Speaker: Imura
rows.Line:
O-Oh, I'm okay!
I had a bit of a flu, is all...
But my fever finally broke just earlier.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Really? Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A-Also...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm really sorry about what I said during the auditions. I feel awful about not taking your feelings into consideration more.

rows.Speaker: Imura
rows.Line:
I'm also sorry...
You were just trying to cheer me up, but I ended up lashing out at you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, you were just...

rows.Speaker: Imura
rows.Line: No, I took all of the anger and frustration I was feeling out on you...

rows.Speaker: Imura
rows.Line: Even going into the audition, I knew that I still didn't have a good grasp of Luca.

rows.Speaker: Imura
rows.Line: But I decided to go in without doing the work, because I wanted to play him so much. I ended up putting on a horrible performance, and the teachers rightly called me out on it.

rows.Speaker: Imura
rows.Line: Then, even though you were just trying to cheer me up, I bit your head off... I really am sorry.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, you don't have to apologize. It's my fault for...

rows.Speaker: Imura
rows.Line:
No, please let me continue!
I want to apologize to you, properly. But that's not all I have to say.

rows.Speaker: Imura
rows.Line: I want to finish by thanking you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Imura
rows.Line: The way you performed during the audition made it clear to me that you really faced Luca head-on.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Imura
rows.Line: That made me really happy.

rows.Speaker: Imura
rows.Line: I ended up getting cut, but you kept trying your absolute best.

rows.Speaker: Imura
rows.Line: Seeing that made me want to stand back up.

rows.Speaker: Imura
rows.Line:
So, thank you. I'm done running...
From auditions, and from my own shortcomings.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
She should be fine.
It's nothing for you to worry about, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I see...
So this is what Byakkomachi meant.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (She must've known that Imura would find the strength to stand back up.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Which is why she just kept watch. Because she believed in her classmate...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Then, why don't we hold a debrief together right now?

rows.Speaker: Imura
rows.Line: Huh? A debrief?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, because I wanna do everything I can. That includes making the most of the results from this time around.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, I'd love to hear what your thought process was, in terms of learning to play Luca.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Because I do genuinely believe that you did a good job of capturing Luca's delicate personality.

rows.Speaker: Imura
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Thanks, Kusanagi. I also really liked your portrayal of Luca...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks. Then, let's discuss this in the courtyard. There are just so many questions that I wanna ask you.
